title: Opening and closing price snapshots for every market we originate
requirement: "Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate" — owner's brief

sources.label: nflverse/nfldata initial_lines.csv — opening lines (WSGT)
sources.coverage: 2021 regular season only; spread and total only; no moneylines

sources.label: No official source publishes betting prices
sources.note: flag F-06 / question Q-02: every value here is a third-party benchmark, never league-verified

conventions.closing_spread: signed game line; positive = home team favored (nflverse DATASETS.md)
conventions.closing_ml: American odds for the named side
conventions.opening_spread: line is for the named team as published; negative = that team favored (initial_lines.csv)
conventions.opening_total: single game total; Over and Under published identical (verified)
conventions.opening_ml: American odds for the named side

flag_codes.NO-CLOSING-LINE-IN-MIRROR: games.csv carries no closing line for this game (future 2026 weeks beyond the posted window). Cell blank — never guessed.
flag_codes.NO-OPENING-DATA-SEASON: initial_lines.csv covers the 2021 regular season only; no opening number exists for this game in any reachable source.
flag_codes.NO-OPENING-MONEYLINE: no reachable source publishes opening moneylines for any season. Cell blank by construction.

checks.what: every present line parses as a number
game set identical to verified results feed
exactly 9 rows per game, no duplicate slot

known_limitations: Opening and closing use different published conventions (per-team opening spread vs signed game closing spread). They are stored verbatim as published; normalising them into one convention is a follow-up before any CLV number is computed from this store.
2021 is the only season with opening data, and it has no opening moneylines — CLV studies on moneylines are impossible from reachable sources (part of Q-02).
No value in this store is official. F-06 stands: a licensed or account price feed is the owner decision that would upgrade the tiers.
